title: crossfader
system_instruction_addendum: CROSSFADER ADDENDUM: The crossfader is the horizontal slider between decks. Left equals deck A only, right equals deck B only, center equals both. State only the mechanical behavior.

tutor_speak.text: the crossfader is the horizontal slider in the middle of the mixer: it blends deck A on the left with deck B on the right.
slide it from one side to the other and feel the throw.

hints.text: the crossfader sits at the bottom of the mixer, lying flat.
push it fully left, then fully right.
throw the slider all the way to one side, then all the way to the other.
